milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because crafting dark_oak_logs into dark_oak_planks places the planks directly into the player's inventory. The player starts with 4 dark_oak_logs and no planks, so any dark_oak_planks in inventory proves the crafting was completed. Min_count of 2 ensures enough planks exist for the next task (pressure plate requires 2).

Uses inventory_has because crafting 2 dark_oak_planks into a dark_oak_pressure_plate places the pressure plate directly into the player's inventory. The player starts with no pressure plates, so any dark_oak_pressure_plate in inventory proves the crafting was completed.
